segments.name: CME
products: futures and options on futures contracts
segments.description: Runs futures exchanges and a clearing house, and sells market data.
segments.evidence: The company reports the results of its operations as one operating segment primarily comprised of the businesses of CME, CBOT, NYMEX, COMEX and our cash markets business.

revenueModel.text: Traders and clearing firms pay transaction and clearing fees, and subscribers pay for market data.
revenueModel.evidence: Derivatives Clearing Business: Through our derivatives clearing house, operated by CME, we provide clearing and settlement services for a broad range of exchange-traded futures and options on futures contracts, exchange-traded swaps and OTC derivatives.
